To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we present Chainspace, a sharded smart contract platform that provides scalability, high availability, auditability and privacy, and we evaluate Chainspace through a prototype implementation.

Chainspace is a distributed ledger platform for smart contracts that provides a scalable, secure, and highly auditability environment for the deployment of privacy-friendly smart contract applications.

Chainspace is a scalable, highly available, secure and privacy-friendly smart contracts platform that can be deployed to support a wide range of smart contract applications, such as the smart metering, smart polling and smart banking examples we have implemented.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design and implementation of a sharded, smart contracts platform that supports privacy-friendly smart contracts.
building the foundations for the next generation of decentralized smart contract systems.
the design and analysis of a distributed ledger infrastructure that is secure, scalable and auditable, and that supports smart contracts.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

Chainspace is the first smart contracts platform with the following properties: (i) it supports a large class of user-defined smart contracts; (ii) it is secure against a large class of Byzantine faults; (iii) its performance is competitive with the state of the art; (iv) its auditability is very strong.
Chainspace is a sharded, scalable, secure, and highly auditability smart contracts platform.
Chainspace is a secure, scalable and efficient sharded platform for smart contracts.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed the first smart contracts system which is scalable, auditable and secure.
we have designed and built a scalable and highly secure sharded smart contracts platform.
we provide a novel smart contracts platform that is scalable, secure and auditable, and that is able to support a number of interesting privacy friendly smart contracts.
The main takeaway from our work is that
Chainspace can be used as a platform for smart contracts that is scalable, secure, auditable, and privacy-friendly.
a sharded distributed ledger can support smart contracts with privacy guarantees, while maintaining scalability and auditability.
sharding is a promising technique for building a scalable and secure blockchain infrastructure.
